survivors.text: Instant SEPA payments mandatory for all euro banks (2025) || Energy cost is a major barrier for ~50% of EU firms; SMEs under-invest in efficiency || Tontine / rotating savings club (ROSCA): members fund each other in turn
survivors.concept: SMEs contribute by instant transfer to a rotating retrofit fund, replacing repeated fundraising and slow collection of member contributions.
survivors.exists: no; closest: MoneyFellows operates consumer savings circles

survivors.text: Mandatory e-invoicing / real-time VAT reporting (ViDA, 2030; national earlier) || Late payment: ~50% of EU invoices paid late; SMEs hit hardest || Spotify royalties: tiny usage events settled into automatic payouts
survivors.concept: SMEs collect customer-authorised micropayments as e-invoice line items are delivered and validated, eliminating payment batching and manual reconciliation.
survivors.exists: partly; Superfluid provides payment streams, Taulia provides invoice-payment automation

survivors.text: Autonomous computer-use agents that operate any web portal || Red tape: EU SMEs cite administrative burden as top obstacle (Eurobarometer 2023) || Blood-bank / organ matching: time-critical allocation of scarce perishable supply
survivors.concept: SMEs let portal agents allocate scarce administrative appointments by deadline and eligibility, eliminating repeated booking attempts and manual appointment triage.
survivors.exists: partly; UiPath supplies portal automation, not this allocation service

survivors.text: Autonomous computer-use agents that operate any web portal || SMEs answer many differently-worded sustainability requests from banks/customers || Container shipping standard (TEU): one box fits every ship, truck, crane
survivors.concept: SMEs maintain one sustainability evidence pack; computer-use agents translate and submit it across customer portals, eliminating repeated portal entry.
survivors.exists: partly; Greenomy handles reporting, UiPath handles portal automation

survivors.text: Autonomous computer-use agents that operate any web portal || Red tape: EU SMEs cite administrative burden as top obstacle (Eurobarometer 2023) || Clinical triage: route cases by urgency with a short standard question set
survivors.concept: SME owners answer a short administrative intake; agents prioritise deadlines and complete relevant portal workflows, eliminating manual routing and repeated form entry.
survivors.exists: partly; Xolo, UiPath cover substantial components

survivors.text: Autonomous computer-use agents that operate any web portal || Grant and subsidy money goes unclaimed; SMEs don't know or can't apply || Clinical triage: route cases by urgency with a short standard question set
survivors.concept: SMEs answer a short eligibility intake; agents rank suitable grants and complete application portals, eliminating irrelevant searches and repetitive application entry.
survivors.exists: partly; Swoop, Granted AI cover matching and application assistance

survivors.text: LLM voice agents that hold natural phone calls in Greek/English || Staff shortages in hospitality/care; workers paid late, shifts unfilled || Blood-bank / organ matching: time-critical allocation of scarce perishable supply
survivors.concept: Care schedulers deploy Greek-English voice agents to confirm credentials and availability for urgent shifts, eliminating repeated staffing calls.
survivors.exists: partly; ConverzAI provides voice-based staffing outreach

survivors.text: Cheap on-device vision models reading paper, meters, shelves in real time || Island grid curtailment: Cyprus wastes solar output at midday (no interconnector) || Air-traffic control: live deconfliction of many actors in shared space
survivors.concept: Cyprus energy aggregators use camera-read legacy meters to dispatch flexible loads around solar surpluses, eliminating manual coordination between otherwise disconnected sites.
survivors.exists: partly; gridX provides dispatch, not the camera-based retrofit

survivors.text: Agents that can pay per request (x402 / stablecoin micropayments) || Island grid curtailment: Cyprus wastes solar output at midday (no interconnector) || Air-traffic control: live deconfliction of many actors in shared space
survivors.concept: Cyprus aggregators dispatch flexible loads through purchasing agents that pay for surplus power and capacity, eliminating manual dispatch negotiation and settlement.
survivors.exists: partly; Piclo, Grid Singularity cover flexibility markets and local trading

survivors.text: EU Data Act: users can demand the data their connected devices generate (from 12 Sep 2025) || SMEs can't get credit: thin files, no collateral (SAFE survey) || Carfax-style history report built from many third-party events
survivors.concept: SME lenders receive authorised equipment utilisation, maintenance and ownership histories, replacing fragmented asset checks when borrowers lack conventional credit files.
survivors.exists: partly; EquipmentWatch provides equipment intelligence, not this complete lending history

survivors.text: Cheap on-device vision models reading paper, meters, shelves in real time || Cyprus water scarcity: desalination dependence, reservoirs below 20% (2025) || Air-traffic control: live deconfliction of many actors in shared space
survivors.concept: Water operators combine camera-read gauges with centrally scheduled valves, eliminating conflicting irrigation requests and manual coordination of scarce flows.
survivors.exists: partly; Rubicon Water provides coordinated irrigation control without camera dependence

survivors.text: Open finance data access (FiDA proposal) beyond payment accounts || Grant and subsidy money goes unclaimed; SMEs don't know or can't apply || Pharmacovigilance: tiny signals from many reports detect rare problems early
survivors.concept: Grant advisers pool consented financial profiles and application outcomes to detect overlooked eligibility patterns, eliminating repeated manual searches for similar SMEs.
survivors.exists: partly; Swoop, Fundica provide funding matching

survivors.text: Smart meters with 15-min data rolling out in Cyprus (EAC AMI programme) || Property and utility disputes between landlords and tenants over shared costs || Pharmacovigilance: tiny signals from many reports detect rare problems early
survivors.concept: Landlords and tenants pool meter-pattern complaints to detect misassigned meters and shared-load billing errors, eliminating repeated manual investigations.
survivors.exists: partly; ista, Gridium provide metering and billing-anomaly analysis

survivors.text: EU Digital Identity Wallet with business attestations (by end-2026) || Red tape: EU SMEs cite administrative burden as top obstacle (Eurobarometer 2023) || Clinical triage: route cases by urgency with a short standard question set
survivors.concept: SMEs answer a short compliance intake; wallet attestations prefill and route required filings, eliminating repeated identity checks and irrelevant applications.
survivors.exists: partly; Xolo handles administration, Signicat handles digital identity
